_설명: 클래스마다 받을 사진(keep)·버릴 사진(reject) 설명. SigLIP 이 모든 설명 중 확률을 나눠 갖고, keep 쪽 합이 keep_min 이상이면 남긴다. sources 는 data/raw/ 아래 수집 폴더(그 안의 <클래스>/)
common_reject: a cartoon illustration or clip art
a vector icon or pictogram on a plain background
a screenshot of text, a document or a web page
a technical drawing with dimensions or a floor plan
a poster or infographic with text and illustrations
a video screenshot with large overlaid captions

keep: a photo of a green emergency exit sign with a running man
a photo of an illuminated green exit sign above a door
a photo of an exit sign on a wall in a building corridor
a product photo of a green emergency exit light with a running man
reject: a photo of a red EXIT sign with text only
a product photo of a blank or unrelated sign
a photo of a building interior without any sign
a photo of a street or outdoor scene

keep: a photo of a red fire extinguisher

a photo of several fire extinguishers on the floor
a photo of people holding fire extinguishers
a photo of a fire hose cabinet on a wall
a photo of a white metal fire hydrant box with a red lamp built into a wall
reject: a photo of a burning fire
a photo of a firefighter or a fire truck
a photo of an empty room or hallway

keep: a photo of a burning candle with a flame
a photo of lit candles in the dark
a close-up photo of a candle flame
a photo of a small lit candle on a table in a room
reject: a photo of unlit candles without flame
a photo of LED flameless electric candles
a photo of a large fire or a bonfire
a photo of a crowd holding candles at night

keep: a photo of an indoor staircase in a building

a photo of an emergency stairwell
